## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Leadership concentrated in Technology (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 top performers Technology) and major-cap divergences (MSFT, META, LLY in RECOVERY) justify a restrained neutral stance pending confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: INTC (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +21.15% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +20.77% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND. Materials and Financials also leading: NUE (1W: +11.84% | 1M: +14.88%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +11.45%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -6.67% | 1M: -2.08%) BELOW TREND. Communication and Consumer Staples show weakness: VZ (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND and WMT (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +21.15% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +20.77% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +15.05% | 1M: +11.00%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +14.49%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: VZ (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -13.06%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -6.67% | 1M: -2.08%) BELOW TREND, OXY (1W: -7.78% | 1M: -0.60%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and select Communications names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers include INTC (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +21.15% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND and AVGO (1W: +20.77% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence signal: MSFT (1W: +3.08% | 1M: -4.35%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +10.73% | 1M: -0.49%) RECOVERY and LLY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: -4.88%) RECOVERY — suppresses a decisive bullish read.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but leading on chip cycle: INTC (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +3.37%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +17.33%) ABOVE TREND; offset by CRM (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -13.06%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -21.16%) BELOW TREND. Sector performance 1W +4.50% across 24 Tech stocks — narrow leadership within semis/cloud names.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive with breadth support: JPM (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +11.45%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +2.44%) ABOVE TREND. Sector performance 1W +4.75% across 20 Financials — confirms role as a reliable leadership sleeve in current market.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed: UNH (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +12.98%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -1.25% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: -4.88%) RECOVERY. Sector performance 1W +1.66% across 17 Healthcare names — selective, watch drug-trial and litigation headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Technology semiconductors and select Financials given current momentum, but temper size due to narrow leadership — favor INTC (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +11.45%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to Energy and lagging Communications; monitor MSFT (1W: +3.08% | 1M: -4.35%) RECOVERY and META (1W: +10.73% | 1M: -0.49%) RECOVERY for confirmation before reloading Growth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +17.33%) ABOVE TREND for chip-cycle follow-through; UNH (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +12.98%) ABOVE TREND for healthcare momentum. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND, VZ (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND and NOW (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -21.16%) BELOW TREND given weak price action despite news in some cases.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +4.50%) and Financials (1W: +4.75%) — watch semiconductors and bank earnings flow. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -4.31%) and Communication (1W: -0.28%) — monitor production/news catalysts and activist/governance headlines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch sustainment of semiconductor strength (INTC, LRCX, AMAT) for 1M confirmation to validate trend continuation. Watch JPM and other Financials for follow-through on 1W strength to confirm broader cyclical participation. Monitor XOM and VZ for persistent BELOW TREND action as downside confirmation that could widen sector weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (+55): AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +17.33%) ABOVE TREND — news on advanced tools confirms price accumulation. LLY (+55): LLY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: -4.88%) RECOVERY — clinical trial progress supports sentiment but price shows short-term recovery, watch follow-through. V (+50): V (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND — payments expansion news aligns with steady price strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
XOM (-45): XOM (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND — production/headline risk confirming price weakness. VZ (-50): VZ (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND — governance/ratings pressure aligning with downside. PLTR (-45): PLTR (1W: -10.52% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND — negative coverage and poor price action confirm distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with Growth/Momentum style tilt given narrow Tech leadership. INTC (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +21.15% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +14.49%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk is major-cap divergence (MSFT RECOVERY, META RECOVERY, LLY RECOVERY) and concentrated leadership — monitor news-price divergences (NOW, ORCL headlines) for confirmation.
